verdict_reason: The tests are correct and pass, but the full-replace test asserts only 4 of 9 copied fields (phone is unasserted on the update path anywhere), concurrency on an unversioned read-modify-write is untested, and three of five tests duplicate OperatorCrudIT's PUT coverage.

todos.issue: putReplacesAllFieldsAndClearsOmittedOptionals asserts only 4 of the 9 fields OperatorService.update() hand-copies (name, addressLine1, townOrCity, countryCode); postcode, phone and email are never asserted on the PUT path here, and phone is asserted nowhere in the whole suite on the update path (OperatorServiceTest lines 178-182 cover postcode/email but not phone), so deleting existing.setPhone(request.phone()) from OperatorService.update() passes every test
todos.fix: Add jsonPath assertions for $.postcode, $.phone and $.email to the 200 response chain and to the repository.findById satisfies() block, so all nine hand-copied setters are covered

todos.issue: No test covers concurrent access to PUT: Address has no @Version field, so OperatorService.update() is an unguarded read-modify-write (findByIdAndOrganisationId then repository.save of the whole document). Two overlapping PUTs silently lose one writer's fields, and a DELETE landing between the update read and its save resurrects the tombstone back to ACTIVE - neither path is exercised here or anywhere in the repo (no @Execution parallel, no CountDownLatch/ExecutorService test)
todos.fix: Add an IT that runs two overlapping PUTs (and a PUT interleaved with a DELETE) via an ExecutorService against the shared Mongo container and asserts the intended outcome; if last-write-wins and tombstone resurrection are accepted, encode that as an explicit documented test, otherwise add @Version to Address and assert the 409/retry

todos.issue: Three of the five tests duplicate PUT tests added by the same PR in OperatorCrudIT: putReplacesAllFieldsAndClearsOmittedOptionals overlaps putReplacesTheMutableFieldsReturns200AndBumpsModifiedAt (line 327) plus putClearsAnOmittedOptionalFieldBecauseItIsAFullReplace (line 358); putBumpsModifiedAtAndPreservesCreatedAt re-covers the same modifiedAt bump; putOnSoftDeletedTombstoneReturns404 duplicates putOnADeletedTombstoneReturns404 (line 377) but asserts strictly less (no Content-Type, no status, no errors-absent check) - two ITs must now be kept in step for one endpoint
todos.fix: Keep the genuinely new cases (per-field 400 errors map, unknown-id 404, createdAt preservation) in AddressUpdateIT and delete the PUT tests from OperatorCrudIT, or fold these into OperatorCrudIT and drop this class - PUT should be owned by exactly one IT

todos.issue: putWithInvalidFieldsReturns400PerFieldErrorsMap saves an ACTIVE address first but never asserts the stored document is untouched after the 400, so a regression that partially applied the body before validation rejected it would go unnoticed
todos.fix: After the 400 assertion add a repository.findById(saved.getId()) check that name/addressLine1/email still hold the pre-request values
